justification: Inspected the package sources under javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/concretesyntaxmodel/ (17 Java files, 1255 total LOC by wc -l). The package is a cohesive concrete-syntax-model layer: most classes are small single-purpose elements such as CsmNone, CsmIndent, CsmUnindent, CsmString, CsmChar, CsmTextBlock, CsmSingleReference, CsmComment, and PrintingHelper, while the larger files (CsmElement 178 LOC, CsmConditional 133, CsmList 133, CsmToken 121) still implement one focused concern each. ConcreteSyntaxModel.java and lexical-preservation classes import these types as a support library, so the package is central to pretty-printing but not an excessively broad multi-responsibility god component.
